success_rule: PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE if (a) legs A, C and E behave exactly as predicted, (b) the entry point runs to completion on all five legs with no uncaught exception, and (c) every frozen input re-hashes to instrument_pins_sha256 afterwards. The outcome of legs B and D is RECORDED AS MEASURED and is NOT part of the pass condition: a confirmed vacuity (prediction) and a falsified vacuity (prediction wrong) are both acceptable preflight results, because either one is the honest envelope of what the direction's successor command can enforce. Predictions are not edited after observation; a falsified prediction is published as a falsification with its wording correction.
